en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan both narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ibn Faďďāl, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from ‘Abdil Khāliq, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The killer of Ḥusain (a.s.) was conceived illegitimately and the killer of Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā (a.s.) was (also) conceived illegitimately.
